_about: Copy this file to lj.config.local.json in the same folder and edit the copy. Use forward slashes in paths. Version 0 of lj.ps1 only LISTS things; nothing in this file can make it delete anything.

photocraft.note: Our notes say (not checked on this PC): Recovery is in %APPDATA%/Photocraft/Recovery up to v0.9.0 and in %LOCALAPPDATA%/Photocraft/Recovery from v0.10.0; a portable zip keeps its data in PhotoCraftData beside the program.

vectorcraft.note: Our notes say (not checked on this PC): %APPDATA%/VectorCraft for an installed copy; a portable zip keeps its data in VectorCraftData beside the program.

lightcraft.note: Our notes say (not checked on this PC): %APPDATA%/LightCraft and a thumbnail cache; a portable zip keeps its data in LightCraftData beside the program; XMP sidecars sit next to the scans (v0 lists the ones under a work folder).

filmcraft.note: Our notes say (not checked on this PC): a portable zip (portable.txt present) keeps a data folder beside the program, otherwise %APPDATA%/FilmCraft; an Auto-Save folder sits next to each project; previews go in a Media Cache folder.

effectcraft.note: Our notes say (not checked on this PC): auto-saves go in a folder named EffectCraft Auto-Save next to the project; settings are in its config folder (a portable zip keeps them beside the program).

soundcraft.note: Learning only, never in the delivery path. Our notes say (not checked on this PC): %APPDATA%/SoundCraft holds Autosave, logs and ui.json.
